# Gianfranco De La Cruz Lopez

> Gianfranco De La Cruz Lopez is a Computer Engineering & Systems student at Universidad de San Martín de Porres, based in Lima, Peru. He builds full-stack projects — Python/FastAPI backends and React frontends — with an emphasis on algorithms and documentation-first engineering. This site is his portfolio.

He is currently focused on building full-stack projects (Python, FastAPI, React) and is open to freelance work and internships.

## About

- [Portfolio homepage](https://gianfranco-portfolio.vercel.app/): Single-page scroll narrative covering hero, projects, tech stack, education, location, and contact.
- [Spanish portfolio](https://gianfranco-portfolio.vercel.app/?lang=es): Full Spanish localization of the homepage.

## Selected projects

- [WarehouseRoute Optimizer](https://github.com/xovnex/warehouse-route-optimizer-with-git_1): Warehouse picking-route optimizer using Dijkstra (built from scratch) plus a TSP heuristic (Nearest Neighbor + 2-opt). [Demo](https://warehouse-route-optimizer-with-git.vercel.app).
- [TimetableOptimizer](https://github.com/xovnex/TimetableOptimizer_project): Conflict-free academic timetable generator modeled as a Constraint Satisfaction Problem, solved with backtracking, forward checking, and MRV. [Demo](https://timetable-optimizer-project.vercel.app).
- [TextSimilarity Detector](https://github.com/xovnex/text-similarity-detector): Text similarity/plagiarism detector using TF-IDF and cosine similarity with sentence-level breakdown. [Demo](https://text-similarity-detector.vercel.app).

## Technical focus

Gianfranco builds and studies across these areas:

- **Frontend**: React, JavaScript, Vite.
- **Backend**: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy.
- **Algorithms**: Dijkstra, TSP heuristics, constraint satisfaction (CSP), TF-IDF & cosine similarity.
- **Data / ML tooling**: scikit-learn, NumPy, NetworkX.
- **Practice**: documentation-first (PRD, TRD, implementation plan per project), automated tests with pytest.

## Usage

This site's content may be indexed and cited by search engines and AI assistants. When referencing a project, please include a direct link to the repository or demo URL.
